```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(jsonlite)

load("shiny_draft_app.RData")

plot_df <- data |>
  select(name, post_draft_nhl) |>
  distinct()

table_df <- data |>
  select(name:pick)

draft_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(plot_df, dataframe = "rows", auto_unbox = TRUE)
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function() {
  function initDraftApp() {
    const rawData = window.DRAFT_DATA || [];
    let selected = [
      'SOGAARD, MADS',
      'JONES, HUNTER',
      'KOCHETKOV, PYOTR',
      'KNIGHT, SPENCER'
    ];

    const pillContainer = document.getElementById('active-pills');
    const searchInput   = document.getElementById('player-search');
    const dropdown      = document.getElementById('player-dropdown');
    const plotContainer = document.getElementById('ggplot-container');

    if (!plotContainer) return;

    function ggplotBlueFill(val) {
      const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(val) || 0));
      const r = Math.round(19 + t * (86 - 19));
      const g = Math.round(43 + t * (177 - 43));
      const b = Math.round(67 + t * (247 - 67));
      return `rgb(${r}, ${g}, ${b})`;
    }

    function renderPlot() {
      const filtered = rawData
        .filter(d => selected.includes(d.name))
        .sort((a, b) => String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name)));

      const width = 920;
      const height = 400;
      const margin = { top: 48, right: 20, bottom: 42, left: 45 };
      const plotW = width - margin.left - margin.right;
      const plotH = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;

      const yTicks = [0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00];
      const yMinor = [0.125, 0.375, 0.625, 0.875];

      let svg = `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" width="100%" style="max-width:${width}px; display:block; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;">`;
      svg += `<text x="${margin.left}" y="18" font-size="13.5" fill="#000000">Probability of Playing One or More Games in the NHL</text>`;
      svg += `<text x="${margin.left}" y="35" font-size="11" fill="#000000">Age 23 or Younger</text>`;
      svg += `<rect x="${margin.left}" y="${margin.top}" width="${plotW}" height="${plotH}" fill="#EBEBEB" />`;

      yMinor.forEach(t => {
        const y = margin.top + plotH * (1 - t);
        svg += `<line x1="${margin.left}" y1="${y}" x2="${margin.left + plotW}" y2="${y}" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="0.75" />`;
      });

      yTicks.forEach(t => {
        const y = margin.top + plotH * (1 - t);
        svg += `<line x1="${margin.left}" y1="${y}" x2="${margin.left + plotW}" y2="${y}" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4" />`;
        svg += `<line x1="${margin.left - 3}" y1="${y}" x2="${margin.left}" y2="${y}" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1" />`;
        svg += `<text x="${margin.left - 6}" y="${y + 3.5}" font-size="9.5" fill="#4D4D4D" text-anchor="end">${t.toFixed(2)}</text>`;
      });

      const n = filtered.length;
      if (n > 0) {
        const step = plotW / n;
        const barW = step * 0.88;
        filtered.forEach((d, i) => {
          const cx = margin.left + step * (i + 0.5);
          const bx = cx - barW / 2;
          const val = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(d.post_draft_nhl) || 0));
          const bh = plotH * val;
          const by = margin.top + plotH - bh;

          svg += `<line x1="${cx}" y1="${margin.top}" x2="${cx}" y2="${margin.top + plotH}" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4" />`;
          svg += `<rect x="${bx}" y="${by}" width="${barW}" height="${bh}" fill="${ggplotBlueFill(val)}" />`;
          svg += `<line x1="${cx}" y1="${margin.top + plotH}" x2="${cx}" y2="${margin.top + plotH + 3}" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1" />`;
          svg += `<text x="${cx}" y="${margin.top + plotH + 14}" font-size="9.5" fill="#4D4D4D" text-anchor="middle">${d.name}</text>`;
        });
      }

      svg += `<text x="${margin.left + plotW / 2}" y="${height - 6}" font-size="11" fill="#000000" text-anchor="middle">Player</text>`;
      svg += `</svg>`;
      plotContainer.innerHTML = svg;
    }

    function renderPills() {
      pillContainer.innerHTML = '';
      selected.forEach(name => {
        const pill = document.createElement('span');
        pill.className = 'player-pill';
        pill.textContent = name;
        pill.title = 'Click to remove';
        pill.onclick = function() {
          selected = selected.filter(n => n !== name);
          renderPills();
          renderPlot();
        };
        pillContainer.appendChild(pill);
      });
    }

    function updateDropdown() {
      const q = searchInput.value.trim().toUpperCase();
      const matches = rawData
        .map(d => d.name)
        .filter(n => !selected.includes(n) && n.toUpperCase().includes(q))
        .slice(0, 30);

      if (matches.length === 0) {
        dropdown.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      dropdown.innerHTML = '';
      matches.forEach(name => {
        const item = document.createElement('div');
        item.className = 'pill-dropdown-item';
        item.textContent = name;
        item.onmousedown = function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          selected.push(name);
          searchInput.value = '';
          dropdown.style.display = 'none';
          renderPills();
          renderPlot();
        };
        dropdown.appendChild(item);
      });
      dropdown.style.display = 'block';
    }

    searchInput.addEventListener('focus', updateDropdown);
    searchInput.addEventListener('input', updateDropdown);
    searchInput.addEventListener('blur', function() {
      setTimeout(() => { dropdown.style.display = 'none'; }, 150);
    });
    searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Backspace' && searchInput.value === '' && selected.length > 0) {
        selected.pop();
        renderPills();
        renderPlot();
      }
    });

    renderPills();
    renderPlot();
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initDraftApp);
  } else {
    initDraftApp();
  }
})();
</script>
```
